description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Rss' for rendering node content as RSS feed items within the Drupal content management system. It includes methods for building options, rendering nodes, and managing RSS-specific data.

classes.name: Rss
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that formats node content as RSS items for views.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm_summary_options
methods.description: Builds options for the summary display mode, including 'Title only'.

methods.name: summaryTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the summary based on selected view mode.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares node data by loading nodes based on IDs before rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a node as an RSS item, constructing RSS-specific elements and view output.
